notes: Stress case for non-classic-ICP gating. Roblox has known offices in London + Brussels + Dublin per their 2024 UK Economic Impact Report, but search coverage for those is flaky (only the careers/HQ page shows up consistently). To avoid testing search-luck rather than gate logic, this case asserts only the stable, gate-deciding fields: operates_in_na=true (San Mateo HQ) and operates_in_scope=true. operates_in_eu / operates_in_uk are deliberately omitted because the model's discovery of secondary offices varies run-to-run.
